mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.create_time, n.update_time, IF(un.is_read IS NULL, 0, un.is_read) AS is_read FROM notice n LEFT JOIN user_notice un ON n.id = un.notice_id AND un.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY n.create_time DESC

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.create_time, n.update_time, IF(un.is_read IS NULL, 0, un.is_read) AS is_read FROM notice n LEFT JOIN user_notice un ON n.id = un.notice_id AND un.user_id = #{userId} WHERE un.is_read IS NULL OR un.is_read = 0 ORDER BY n.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notice (notice_id, user_id, is_read, read_time) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{userId}, 1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_read = 1, read_time = NOW()
